transcript:
user: What does N+1 mean when using an ORM?
assistant: One query fetches a list, then the ORM issues one more query per item to load a relationship — N+1 queries where one join would do. Eager loading or a batched select fixes it.
required_points: one query for a list then one per item
eager loading or batching fixes it
notes: A definition plus its remedy. Checks that a summary keeps the actionable half rather than only the diagnosis.
